job_spec.purpose: el1011-ds-misc/pqc structural redesign of ot_v41_pqc_spine_screen (audit class 1: one clock tree over 133k/225k sinks, CTS hold stuck -65 ps for 8 h, all 5 pqc jobs cancelled): the screen becomes a composition of hardened tiles. This job routes the quantiser SUB-TILE T_AQ ot_dsrom_aq12t (aq12m bit/cycle exact; the 1024b x 20 wait line = 20,480 flops moved into a 4 x SRAM 128x256 ring with capture flops; ~11.5k flops + 4 macros; x/v pin flops top face, output flops bottom face), variant a: 280.8 x 172.8 um, 2x2 SRAM macros, PD 0.55, view PDN (pdn_view_sram.tcl, M7 PG pins); the screen composes 2 of its views.

rtl_boundary.waive: el1011-ds-misc/pqc: every data input is captured in a pin flop (s0_x; v enters the vline flop chain); every output (vo/q/e/y/fault) is a flop; SRAM inputs from flops (r_wp/r_rp/s0_x), SRAM outputs into capture flops (xg_r).

calibrate.reason: Current master flow measures real boundary clock in-run at each corner, no borrowed insertion.
